description: Outcome-based review of the visual defect described in instruction.md: in the Leader Den screen's other-clan tile (the clickable card that shows a neighbouring clan's name, temperament, and standing toward the player's clan), the standing text is not showing correctly.

criteria.criterion: In the Leader Den screen's other-clan tile, when the clan-name/temperament lines above the standing text wrap onto extra lines, pushing the standing text further down the tile, the standing text remains fully visible while the tile is hovered instead of being cut off or obscured by the tile's border or hover decoration.

The fix keeps the other-clan tile's standing text fully visible on hover across different clan-name/temperament lengths and combinations that push the standing text downward. The fix generalizes to any clan name, temperament, or standing value rather than special-casing a particular literal one.

Every text value in the other-clan tile - clan name, temperament words, standing text - keeps its original full content and stays visible after the fix. The fix resolves the covering issue through layout changes, keeping all of that text intact rather than shortening, hiding, or truncating it.
The other-clan tile continues to show its visible hover border/feedback after the fix; the hover state is not disabled or suppressed to work around the standing text being covered.
